title.narrative: Empowering Civil Society Organizations for Transparency (ECSOFT) Activity

description.narrative: The objective of the ECSOFT activity is to enhance the capacity and sustainability of CSOs representing a broad range of Azerbaijani society, and select government.agencies, to help local, municipal, and national governments increase.transparency and accountability. As part of the Embassy's focus on anti-corruption and promoting transparency, ECSOFT will also develop the capacity and financial sustainability of existing and emerging civil society organizations working in this area, strive to increase public awareness of the current level of corruption, advocate for legal protections of civil society.involved in anti-corruption activities, and increase civic advocacy for greater transparency and accountability of Azerbaijan's state institutions and.businesses.
